message: Root cause: tile-wide pointer dragging uses pointer capture and does not produce native sidebar drop events, so dragging a page to a sidebar note ended with pointerup and no move. Fix: while pointer-dragging, detect sidebar notebook under pointer coordinates with elementFromPoint, show drop-hover, and on pointerup call existing movePageToNotebook. Browser verification used a stubbed fetch: pointer drag from page image to Quick produced /move with target_notebook=Quick, removed tile locally, and did not dirty reorder state. Tests: full suite 303 passed, 4 deselected.
